elements.label: Figure A12
elements.title: Select Data Pop-Up Window on MS Excel (Used with permission from Microsoft)
elements.details: Screenshot of the Select Data pop-up window in MS Excel. It shows the Chart data range set to =Sheet1!$A$1:$F$13. The Legend entries (Series) list three entries: Height (inches), Weight (pounds), and Age. The Name field is set to =Sheet1!$D$1 and Y values to =Sheet1!$D$2:$D$13. The Horizontal (Category) axis labels are set to =Sheet1!$A$2:$C$13.
elements.summary: This pop-up window allows users to define the data range and series for a chart in Excel, showing three series (Height, Weight, Age) and the corresponding axis labels.
